tokens.v: Two orders for the same item can take completely different routes, and the difference is decided before anything is created.
If on-hand plus on-order already covers the demand, order planning generates nothing and the sales order goes straight to picking and shipping —
If it does not, MRP proposes, the transfer makes those proposals real, and Procurement and Manufacturing supply what is missing.

blocks.text: Two orders for the same item can take completely different routes, and the difference is decided before anything is created. If on-hand plus on-order already covers the demand, order planning generates nothing and the sales order goes straight to picking and shipping — stages 3 and 4 never happen. If it does not, MRP proposes, the transfer makes those proposals real, and Procurement and Manufacturing supply what is missing.

tokens.v: A number is a position on the walk.

The ten numbered tiles are what a reader passes through in order — the steps they take, the checkpoints the route turns on, and the shipment that ends it — numbered in the order they are walked rather than the order the lanes are printed, so
because the components have to be on hand before the order can consume them.

blocks.text: A number is a position on the walk. The ten numbered tiles are what a reader passes through in order — the steps they take, the checkpoints the route turns on, and the shipment that ends it — numbered in the order they are walked rather than the order the lanes are printed, so 8 · Warehouse Receipt comes before 9 · Production Orders because the components have to be on hand before the order can consume them.

tokens.v: Seven tiles carry no number, for three different reasons.
Four are setup: what must already be true before the walk starts, and they reach the walk by

. Three are results the system produced on its own — the two proposals MRP wrote, and the finished item in stock. Two are inquiries, and an inquiry carries no edge at all: it is a detour taken for information, and the walk is the same whether or not you take it.
§5 settled that a reading is not a step, and
§1 records the five categories these tiles fall into.

blocks.text: Seven tiles carry no number, for three different reasons. Four are setup: what must already be true before the walk starts, and they reach the walk by feed rather than by flow. Three are results the system produced on its own — the two proposals MRP wrote, and the finished item in stock. Two are inquiries, and an inquiry carries no edge at all: it is a detour taken for information, and the walk is the same whether or not you take it. exchange/send-atlas-5-reply.md §5 settled that a reading is not a step, and exchange/send-atlas-4-reply.md §1 records the five categories these tiles fall into.
